verdict.rationale: Rootly docs confirm push-style alerts via its mobile app and phone-call paging via Live Call Routing, plus escalation policies with multi-step targets and delays, but there is no explicit documentation of SMS or email as notification channels, nor of user-configurable per-channel notification rules (e.g., 'push first, then SMS, then call'). missing for 10: SMS channel support, email channel support, explicit per-channel notification-rule configuration UI/API.
